_instructions: Voice settings, read live. Limits and timeouts apply to the next dictation or reply; threads and pause_detection apply when a model next loads. idle_unload_minutes: free a model's memory after this long unused (0 keeps it loaded; the next use then waits a few seconds while it loads). dictation: max_concurrent dictations across all users; idle_capture_seconds before an abandoned dictation is dropped; finish_timeout_seconds to wait for the last passage; max_recording_seconds per dictation; tidy drops um/uh and accidentally doubled words from the transcript locally; editor (default for agents whose Identity voice section does not choose) sends the finished transcript once to the agent's System model, if one is assigned, to remove other fillers and repeats and fix punctuation; pause_detection closes a phrase after min_silence_seconds of silence (threshold = speech probability, phrases shorter than min_speech_seconds are ignored, unbroken speech is cut at max_phrase_seconds, and lead_in_seconds of audio before each phrase is included so a soft first word is kept); each phrase is a live draft, and once passage_seconds of speech ends at a pause the whole passage is transcribed in one piece and replaces the draft, as finish does for the last one. speech: max_chars of a reply read aloud; queue_wait_seconds a reply waits for the one before it.
